text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... To get this exhausted 
from just 1,800 meters...! Still, I'll 
definitely overcome this through training!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My beautiful voice has been taken over by 
aliens again! And the cause is... 
epiglottic entrapment!?
